content_sections.heading: About Sukma Police
content_sections.text: The Office of the Superintendent of Police, Sukma, is the police office issuing this recruitment and is based at the Composite Building, Kumharras, Sukma. The posts fall under the Chhattisgarh Police Special Executive Force (Bastar Fighter), and the recruitment follows the rules of the Home (Police) Department.

content_sections.text: Only eligible candidates who are local residents of Sukma district can apply. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Sukma Police Fighter Constable Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Get the application in the prescribed format. It is displayed on the notice boards of all police stations in Sukma district, the police sub-divisional officer offices and the Superintendent of Police Office. Fill in the application in that format. Hand it in during office days and hours, from the start date, at the Superintendent of Police Office, District Sukma, or at a Sub-Divisional Officer (Police) office in Sukma, Dornapal, Konta, Jagargunda or Maraiguda. Or send it by registered Indian Post to: Superintendent of Police Office, Composite Building, Kumharras, Sukma, PIN 494111.

faq.question: Q1. Can candidates from outside Sukma district apply?
faq.answer: No. This recruitment is open only to eligible local residents of Sukma district.

faq.question: Q2. How many posts are reserved for Scheduled Tribe candidates?
faq.answer: Scheduled Tribe candidates have 315 of the 375 posts, the largest share of any category.

faq.question: Q3. How many posts are open to unreserved candidates?
faq.answer: There are 26 unreserved posts, the same number as for Other Backward Classes.

faq.question: Q4. At what time do applications close on the last date?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted by 5:00 PM on 12 December 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Can I apply by post?
faq.answer: Yes, by registered Indian Post to the Superintendent of Police Office at the Composite Building, Kumharras, Sukma.

faq.question: Q6. Which offices accept applications by hand?
faq.answer: The Superintendent of Police Office and the Sub-Divisional Officer (Police) offices at Sukma, Dornapal, Konta, Jagargunda and Maraiguda accept them.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I see the physical test and written exam details?
faq.answer: They are displayed on the notice boards of police stations and police offices in Sukma district. Detailed rules can also be checked on cgpolice.gov.in, sukma.cgpolice.gov.in or www.sukma.gov.in.
